TASK_API.description: REST API for creating, updating, and completing tasks

NOTIFICATION_SYSTEM.description: Event-driven notification pipeline — reacts to task changes

UserSubmitsTask.description: Entry point — user submits a new task via the API

TaskController.description: Express route handler for /api/tasks. Validates input, delegates to TaskService, emits events via EventBus.

TaskService.description: Business logic layer. Enforces rules (max tasks per user, deadline validation). Returns domain objects, not HTTP responses.

TaskStore.description: In-memory task storage with Map. Provides CRUD + query by status/assignee.

EventBus.description: Type-safe publish/subscribe event bus. Emits TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, TaskDeleted events.

NotificationService.description: Subscribes to task events and sends notifications. Currently logs to console, designed for email/webhook extension.

_tags: @gotcha("Must check task limit BEFORE creating — TaskService.createTask throws if limit exceeded")

_options.reason: EventBus<EventMap> with a mapped type interface ensures emit() and on() share the same payload type per event name. Compile-time safety, zero runtime cost.
_options.evidence: src/events.ts demonstrates the pattern with TaskEventMap

_options.reason: Untyped string events (bus.emit('task:created', data)) have no compile-time safety. Payload mismatches only caught at runtime.

TypeSafeEvents.problem: How to enforce type safety on event payloads across publishers and subscribers?
TypeSafeEvents.revisit_when: project moves to a framework with built-in typed events (e.g., tRPC subscriptions)

STORE_MAP_ORDERING.what: Tasks returned by getByStatus() were in insertion order, not creation date order
STORE_MAP_ORDERING.why: JavaScript Map preserves insertion order, which matches creation order only if tasks are never updated. Updates that delete+re-insert change the order.
STORE_MAP_ORDERING.fix: Added explicit sort by createdAt after Map.values() collection
STORE_MAP_ORDERING.invariant: All query methods on TaskStore must sort results by createdAt descending

test_store_ordering.description: Verify getByStatus returns tasks sorted by createdAt descending after updates

test_event_type_safety.description: Verify EventBus enforces correct payload types at compile time

MAX_TASKS_PER_USER.why: 100 is the practical limit for a single user dashboard. Above 100, UI pagination becomes mandatory and query performance degrades on the in-memory store.
MAX_TASKS_PER_USER.recalibrate_when: storage moves from in-memory Map to a database with pagination

TASK_API_GUIDE.workflow: Request → TaskController validates → TaskService enforces rules → TaskStore persists → EventBus emits → NotificationService reacts
TASK_API_GUIDE.critical_first: All mutations go through TaskService, never directly to TaskStore. The service layer enforces business rules (task limits, deadline validation). Bypassing it creates invalid state.

read_before_touching.EventBus: decision TypeSafeEvents — understand the generic pattern before adding events

TaskEventMap.description: Central event map — all event names and their payload types defined here. Adding a new event requires adding it to this interface.

STORE_MAP_DELETE_REINSERT.what: Map.delete + Map.set changes iteration order — updates must re-sort
STORE_MAP_DELETE_REINSERT.why: JavaScript Map preserves insertion order. Deleting and re-inserting a key moves it to the end.
STORE_MAP_DELETE_REINSERT.fix: All query methods sort by createdAt before returning
